# IndiBrick

> IndiBrick is an Ontario mortgage brokerage and real estate platform, founded in 2024 by Mudit Chhura and Saad Shaikh, headquartered in Vaughan, Ontario, Canada. Mortgages are brokered through Pineapple Financial Inc. (FSRA #12830). Real estate is fulfilled by a licensed realtor partner network. We serve the Greater Toronto Area, Vaughan, Brampton, Mississauga, and the Niagara Region.

## Entity identifiers

- Legal name: IndiBrick Financial
- Trade name: IndiBrick
- License: FSRA Mortgage Brokerage #12830 (held by Pineapple Financial Inc.)
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: 60 Pippin Road, Unit 34, Vaughan, Ontario, L4K 4M8, Canada
- Founders: Mudit Chhura, Saad Shaikh
- Website: https://indibrick.ca

## What we do

- Wholesale mortgage brokerage: insured, insurable, uninsured, B-lender, private capital, second mortgages
- Real estate co-brokerage through licensed realtor partner network
- Tech-enabled legal closings (fixed-fee, digital signing)
- Architecture, renovation permitting, and wealth strategy
- Pre-construction investment advisory

## Mortgage products

Live pricing: https://indibrick.ca/rates

- Insured (high-ratio) mortgages — variable and fixed
- Insurable renewals and transfers
- Uninsured refinances
- Alternative B-lender mortgages
- Private capital / asset-based mortgages
- Second mortgages up to 85% LTV

## Who we serve

First-time buyers, investors, self-employed borrowers, credit-challenged homeowners, real estate investors, commercial borrowers, pre-construction buyers.

## Service areas

Vaughan, Woodbridge, Brampton, Mississauga, Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Markham, Richmond Hill, St. Catharines, Niagara Region, Hamilton, Oakville, Burlington, Ottawa.

## Named data assets

- IndiBrick Ontario Housing Index — monthly benchmark price by city, property type and price band. Derived from CREA MLS® HPI + TRREB Market Watch. Human-readable at /housing-index; machine-readable at /api/housing-index/latest.json.
- IndiBrick Ontario Wholesale Rate Tracker — live 5-year fixed and variable rates across 40+ Canadian lenders, updated whenever wholesale sheets change. Live at /rates.

## CRM SaaS platform (IndiBrick Partner)

- IndiBrick Partner is our CRM SaaS platform for Ontario realtors and insurance agents. Free-forever base tier, optional Marketing Pro tier ($149 CAD/month per seat), and done-for-you Managed Ads tiers ($897 / $1497 / $2497 CAD/month).
- Landing pages: https://indibrick.ca/for-realtors and https://indibrick.ca/for-insurance-agents
- Pricing and tier comparison: https://indibrick.ca/pricing
- Competitive positioning:
  - vs GoHighLevel: https://indibrick.ca/vs-gohighlevel
  - vs Follow Up Boss: https://indibrick.ca/vs-follow-up-boss
